s: an intimate, deeply personal Korean tasting-menu counter with a devoted, hard-to-book following
w: An upstairs counter room reworking Korean cuisine course by course through a numbered tasting menu, each dish paired with a printed card explaining its history. Chef Junghyun Park and Ellia Park built a following intense enough that reservations vanish within minutes of release. Consistently ranked among the world's best restaurants, it's cited alongside Tokyo's sushi counters as an example of scarcity and obsessive detail feeding cult status.
_facts: Located at 104 E 30th St, New York, NY 10016 (NoMad/Kips Bay)
Run by chef Junghyun "JP" Park and Ellia Park
Serves a numbered, Korean-history-themed tasting menu at a small upstairs counter
Ranked in the top tier of the World's 50 Best Restaurants list
